test_objective: Check that one can retrieve the temporal evolution of a scope following the deletedAt temporal property with temporal values
keywords: Delete Temporal Attribute and Retrieve Temporal Evolution of Attribute

test_cases.name: 020_20_01 With a Scope
test_cases.doc: Check that one can retrieve the temporal evolution of a scope following the deletedAt temporal property with temporal values
test_cases.template: Delete Temporal Attribute and Retrieve Temporal Evolution of Attribute
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Retrieve Temporal Representation Of Entity with Response Status Code set to 200     and
        Retrieve Temporal Representation Of Entity with Response Body containing EntityTemporal element containing attribute instances in the time range specified by the NGSI-LD temporal query:
            * the payload is defined in the file set to 'vehicle-temporal-representation-property-020-20.jsonld'
            * the id was changed to 'temporal_entity_representation_id=${temporal_entity_representation_id}'
            * response body to be checked set to 'response_body=${response2.json()}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}?${params_as_string}'
        method set to 'DELETE'
        Delete Entity Attributes: and
    Query Parameter: entityId set to '${temporal_entity_representation_id}' and
    Query Parameter: attributeId set to 'scope' and
    Query Parameter: datasetId set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: deleteAll set to 'false' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
